The first validated database release will accompany the associated review article. Article and dataset citation details will be added with the release, and they will have separate persistent identifiers.

## Review-paper citation

The review-paper citation will be added after publication.

## Database citation

The database citation will identify the release version, project contributors, and the persistent dataset record.

## Dataset DOI

No dataset DOI has been assigned yet. The Zenodo version DOI will be added here after the first deliberate manual upload.

Suggested citation text will be provided with the first release. Please cite both the associated paper and the specific database version used in an analysis.
